inventory-operations.summary: Write down every operation and feature the current {{sdk}} SDK has.
acceptance: A list in the design names every operation and feature of the current {{sdk}} SDK

inventory-gaps.summary: Turn each gap in the gap list into a task.
acceptance: Each gap in the gap list has a task in this spec

codegen-client.summary: Generate the new client from the service models.

codegen-compare.summary: Compare the generated client with the old one.
acceptance: Every difference from the old client is listed and explained

runtime-port.summary: Port transport, auth, retries and paging to the new runtime.
acceptance: Requests are sent, signed, retried and paged on the new runtime

protocol-tests-run.summary: Run the protocol test suite and fix what fails.
acceptance: The protocol test suite runs against the new client
Every protocol test passes against the new client

team-review.summary: The team reviews the runtime and protocol results before cutover.
acceptance: The team agreed the runtime and protocol results are good enough to cut over

cutover-callers.summary: Switch callers to the new client.
acceptance: Every caller uses the new client
The callers' own tests pass against the new client with no change to their code

cutover-notes.summary: Write the release notes for the cutover.
acceptance: The release notes list every change callers can see
